title: Openflow CDC Connector Packing Config
description: Config schema: parameter keys under shared.source / shared.snowflake / connectors[].overrides are NiFi parameter names verbatim (legacy short aliases are also accepted and canonicalized). Per-type required-field enforcement happens at apply time (the NiFi connector reports INVALID with a clear bulletin if a required parameter is missing) — see cdc-connector-packing.md §Step 5.

runtime.description: Name of the pre-existing Openflow runtime. The skill never creates runtimes.

secretRef.description: Reference to a secret. Supported schemes: <key> (cortex), snowflake:DB.SCHEMA.SECRET. Templated tokens like ${connector.name|upper} are allowed inside any reference.

snowflake.description: Goes into the Destination context. Keys are NiFi parameter names verbatim (e.g. 'Snowflake Account Identifier', 'Snowflake Authentication Strategy').

source.description: Goes into the Source context. Keys are NiFi parameter names verbatim (e.g. 'PostgreSQL Username', 'PostgreSQL Password', 'Publication Name'). The single special key is 'jdbc_driver_url' which drives the JDBC asset upload (not a NiFi parameter).

ingestion.description: Applied to every Ingestion context (per-connector, same value). Keys are NiFi parameter names verbatim.

name.description: ≤32 chars, unique. Doubles as the per-connector Ingestion context name.

overrides.description: Per-connector overrides applied to the Ingestion context. Keys are NiFi parameter names verbatim.
